pairs.evidence: src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:86 Athena Companion drives the avatar mouth opening directly from low-mid band audio frequency energy on an unthrottled requestAnimationFrame loop, deviating from speech-timed viseme mapping and mirrored face signaling.

techniques.evidence: src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:95 The canvas animation runs an unthrottled continuous rAF loop without settling at rest or pausing off-screen, and multiple surfaces each compute their own independent loops.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:108 The companion uses a looping pre-rendered video with an overlay rather than selecting between layered rig, neural, or hybrid routes.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:55 No neural audio-to-motion model or latent retargeting is present; animation is driven directly by browser Web Audio analyser frequency data.
src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:68 Narration and companion rendering are client-side UI components without a neural model generation pipeline requiring paced realtime lag benchmarking.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:30 The companion reads audio analysis directly in-process from React context, with no neural inference or out-of-process sidecar required.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:62 Presence motion is limited to a single periodic sine wave breath, omitting layered noise drift, blinks, saccades, text gestures, and resting settlement.

src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:51 Motion extraction and 2D canvas drawing are tightly coupled inside an internal component loop rather than adhering to a versioned parameter vector with a pure draw interface.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:109 The avatar relies on a video loop rather than decomposing a single portrait into drivable deformation layers.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:86 The mouth height is modulated directly by low-mid band audio frequency amplitude without viseme mapping, speech timing, or closure protection.

pairs.registryProposal: When an avatar in a web product tour combines a pre-rendered looping video asset with an audio-reactive canvas overlay (rather than a static still or neural model), the standard should explicitly classify this hybrid composite tier under motion-route-selection and clarify whether loudness-only mouth dilation on a video base is permissible or treated strictly as viseme-drive deviation.
